app.name: YayGUI
nav.label: Main navigation
terminal.title: Terminal
placeholder.home.desc: Update counts, Arch News, cache size and a one-click system upgrade are coming here.
placeholder.updates.desc: Grouped repo and AUR updates with version changes and review status are coming here.
placeholder.installed.desc: Browse explicitly installed, foreign and orphaned packages, with bulk removal, coming here.
placeholder.maintenance.desc: Cache cleaner, orphan cleanup, package stats and pacman log history are coming here.
placeholder.settings.desc: App preferences, yay options, hooks and notifier settings are coming here.
search.title: Search
search.emptyInitial.title: Search for packages
search.emptyInitial.desc: Type a name or keyword to search the official repositories and the AUR.
search.empty.title: No packages found
search.empty.desc: Nothing matches "{query}" with the current filters. Try a different term or relax the filters.
search.error.title: Search failed
search.error.desc: The package search could not be completed.
search.aurError: AUR results are unavailable: {message}. Showing repository results only.
search.aurShort: AUR searches need at least 2 characters.
pkg.notFound: This package is not in the current results.
pkg.field.name: Name
pkg.tabs.coming: Dependencies, files, PKGBUILD, comments and risk signals are coming here.
queue.title: Queue
queue.empty.title: The queue is empty
queue.empty.desc: Add packages from search, or queue a full system upgrade below.
queue.upgradeHint: Updates every package (yay -Syu). Required when installing repo packages, so the system is never partially upgraded.
queue.planFailed: The queue could not be checked: {message}
queue.commandsHint: Exactly these programs and arguments are started, one after another. Nothing runs as root; sudo asks for your password when needed.
queue.reviewsHint: AUR packages are made by users and are not checked by Arch Linux. Read each PKGBUILD before it is built.
queue.lockHeld: Another package manager is using the pacman database (/var/lib/pacman/db.lck exists). Close it and check again. If nothing else is running, the lock is left over from a crash.
queue.error.partial_upgrade: Installing repo packages without a full system upgrade can break your system (a partial upgrade). Add the full system upgrade to continue.
queue.error.unreviewed: Review every AUR package below before it can be built.
queue.skipReview: Build AUR packages without review in this session
queue.skipReviewWarning: Not recommended. A malicious PKGBUILD can run any command as your user while it builds. This setting resets when the app closes.
queue.runHint: Ctrl+Enter opens the queue from anywhere.
review.title: Review {name}
review.warning: Anyone can upload to the AUR. Check where sources are downloaded from, what the build and install scripts do, and anything that runs curl, wget, base64 or eval.
review.previous: You approved commit {commit} on {date}. The first tab shows what changed since then.
review.previousGone: You approved commit {commit} on {date}, but it is no longer in the repository (history was rewritten). Review all files again.
review.binary: Binary or large file ({size} bytes), not shown.
review.symlink: Symbolic link to {target}. It is not followed.
review.truncated: This repository has more files than can be shown.
review.approveHint: Only this exact commit will be built. If the package changes before it is built, the build is stopped.
tx.title: Transaction
tx.none: No transaction has run in this session.
tx.interrupted: The app closed while the last transaction was running. Check the pacman log (/var/log/pacman.log) and run a full system upgrade to make sure the system is consistent.
tx.cancelHint: Sends Ctrl+C. Cancelling during installation can leave the system half-updated.
tx.password.title: Password for {user}
tx.password.desc: sudo needs your password. It goes straight to sudo and is not stored.
tx.password.label: Password
tx.question: Question from yay
tx.menu.title: yay is asking
tx.menu.label: Answer
tx.succeeded: All done. The queue has been cleared.
tx.hint.db_lock: Another package manager holds the pacman database lock. Close it, or remove /var/lib/pacman/db.lck if nothing else is running.
tx.hint.target_not_found: A package was not found. Refresh the package databases with a full system upgrade.
tx.hint.commit_failed: pacman could not finish the transaction. The log above says why.
tx.hint.conflicting_files: Files on disk conflict with the new package. See the Arch Wiki on resolving file conflicts.
tx.hint.build_failed: An AUR package failed to build. Check the log, the package's AUR comments, and whether it is flagged out of date.
